description: This file contains security-related functions for authentication and authorization in a FastAPI application, including password hashing, JWT token creation, and user retrieval from tokens.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verify a plain password against its hashed form.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Create a JWT access token for a given subject (e.g., username).

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to retrieve the current authenticated user from Bearer token.
